_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime (3% ±2 score moves) plus mid-scale fear/momentum/funding and dead ETF bids make HOLD the graded call; OPEX mean-down lean is weak vs CVD/extreme crowding conflict.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/SKIP OPEX; narrative accumulation-positive without a directional phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Through OPEX, BTC holds ~80-81k shelf with fear/greed and 30d momentum still mid-scale and phase score unmoved ±2
next_move.invalidated_if: Lose 80k with flat ETF flows and crowded longs (slide toward Anxiety), or CVD+flow turn lifts fear and momentum together into Disbelief
